info.description:
Backend API for Smart Invest Solutions — a LIC Policy & Investment Management Platform.
This API provides user registration, authentication with JWT, role-based access control, and more.
info.title: Smart Invest Solutions API

get.description: Retrieves all access requests with optional filtering by status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED).

parameters.description: Filter by status: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED
parameters.name: status

post.description: Submits a request for access to the platform with Name, Contact No, and Email. Status is set to PENDING until approved by an Admin.
post.summary: Request for Access (Client Sign up request)

400.description: Bad request (email already exists or pending request exists)

get.description: Retrieves detailed info for a single access request.
get.summary: Get Access Request by ID (Admin Only)

post.description: Approves a client's access request. Automatically generates a secure random password, creates a User account, updates request status to APPROVED, and emails login credentials to the client via Resend.
post.summary: Approve Access Request & Email Credentials (Admin Only)

200.description: Access request approved, account created, and credentials emailed

400.description: Bad request (already approved or invalid ID)

post.description: Rejects a client's access request and marks status as REJECTED.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all admin and super_admin accounts. Only accessible by super_admin.
get.summary: Get all Admin accounts (Super Admin only)

post.description: Creates a new Admin account from Name/Email/Phone. Auto-generates a unique Admin ID, a random password, and a 4-digit PIN, then emails the credentials to the new admin. The response also returns the plaintext password/PIN once, so the Super Admin can share them even if the email fails to deliver. Only accessible by super_admin.

400.description: Bad request (e.g. email already in use)

post.description: Authenticates an admin or super_admin account using AdminID + PIN. Normal users (client/advisor) cannot log in through this endpoint — use POST /users/login instead. Returns a JWT token containing the user's role. Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed attempts.

parameters.description: Login credentials — Admin ID and 4-digit PIN
parameters.name: request

200.description: Login successful — returns JWT token and user details with role

401.description: Invalid credentials, account disabled, or account temporarily locked

delete.description: Permanently deletes an admin account and its associated data. Self-deletion is disallowed — use the account settings delete option instead. Only accessible by super_admin.

get.description: Retrieves list of all documents uploaded by the user with optional search query filter `q`.

parameters.description: Search filter by name or category (e.g. aadhaar, pan, passbook)
parameters.name: q

post.description: Uploads a PDF or image file with auto-compression to Cloudinary and saves metadata to MongoDB E-Vault.

parameters.description: Category (Aadhaar, PAN, Bank Passbook, Policy, Custom)
parameters.name: category

get.description: Retrieves all E-Vault documents for a target client user.
Retrieves detailed info and secure link for a single document.

put.description: Updates document name/category or replaces file. Replacing a file purges the old Cloudinary asset automatically.

delete.description: Deletes document record from MongoDB and purges file from Cloudinary storage.

get.description: Retrieves list of all family members added by the authenticated user along with total count N.

post.description: Creates a new family member record linked to the authenticated user.

get.description: Retrieves all family members associated with a specific user ID for Admin/Advisor view.
Retrieves detailed info for a single family member.

put.description: Updates specific details (name, relation, phone, email, blood group, DOB) of a family member.

delete.description: Removes a family member from the authenticated user's account.

get.description: Clients receive their own Fixed Deposits (unpaginated list + total). Admin/super_admin receive a paginated master list across all clients (page, limit, is_mapped query params), each row enriched with the customer's name and contact number.

parameters.description: Items per page — Admin only (default: 10, max: 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Filter by mapped status — Admin only
parameters.name: is_mapped

post.description: Creates a new Fixed Deposit / Postal instrument mapped to a specific family member (1st Holder). Clients create FDs under their own account; admin/super_admin may target any client by passing user_id in the body.

get.description: Retrieves detailed info for a single Fixed Deposit. Clients can only access their own; admin/super_admin can access any.

404.description: Fixed Deposit not found or access denied

put.description: Updates FD fields. Clients can only update their own FDs; admin/super_admin can update any. The is_mapped admin-tracking flag can ONLY be changed by admin/super_admin — if a client includes it in the request body, it is silently ignored and the existing value is preserved.

404.description: Fixed Deposit not found or access denied

delete.description: Removes a Fixed Deposit. Clients can only delete their own; admin/super_admin can delete any.

get.description: Retrieves list of all general/vehicle insurance policies for the authenticated user.
get.summary: Get all my General Insurance policies

post.description: Creates a new general/vehicle insurance policy linked to the authenticated user account.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated master list of every general/vehicle insurance policy across all clients — Customer Name, Contact No, Vehicle No, Policy No, Date of Expiry, Company Name — for the Admin dashboard. Accessible by admin and super_admin.
get.summary: Get all clients' General Insurance policies (Admin Only)

get.description: Retrieves all general insurance policies associated with a specific user ID for Admin/Advisor view.
get.summary: Get user's General Insurance policies (Admin Only)

get.description: Retrieves detailed info for a single general insurance policy.
get.summary: Get General Insurance policy by ID

put.description: Updates vehicle no, policy no, date of expiry, company name, or advisor info.

delete.description: Removes a general insurance policy from the authenticated user account.

get.description: Clients receive their own policies (unpaginated list + total). Admin/super_admin receive a paginated master list across all clients (page, limit, is_mapped query params), each row enriched with the customer's name and contact number.

parameters.description: Items per page — Admin only (default: 10, max: 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Filter by mapped status — Admin only
parameters.name: is_mapped

post.description: Creates a new health insurance policy mapped to a specific family member (primary insured). Clients create policies under their own account; admin/super_admin may target any client by passing user_id in the body.

get.description: Retrieves detailed info for a single health insurance policy. Clients can only access their own; admin/super_admin can access any.
get.summary: Get Health Insurance policy by ID

404.description: Policy not found or access denied

put.description: Updates policy/premium fields. Clients can only update their own policies; admin/super_admin can update any. The is_mapped admin-tracking flag can ONLY be changed by admin/super_admin — if a client includes it in the request body, it is silently ignored and the existing value is preserved. Reassigning family_member_id re-validates ownership and refreshes the cached primary_insured_name.

404.description: Policy not found or access denied

delete.description: Removes a health insurance policy. Clients can only delete their own; admin/super_admin can delete any.

get.description: Clients receive their own policies (unpaginated list + total). Admin/super_admin receive a paginated master list across all clients (page, limit, is_mapped query params), each row enriched with the customer's name and contact number.

parameters.description: Items per page — Admin only (default: 10, max: 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Filter by mapped status — Admin only
parameters.name: is_mapped

post.description: Creates a new life insurance policy mapped to a specific family member. Clients create policies under their own account; admin/super_admin may target any client by passing user_id in the body ("Select Member" flow).

get.description: Retrieves detailed info for a single life insurance policy. Clients can only access their own; admin/super_admin can access any.
get.summary: Get Life Insurance policy by ID

404.description: Policy not found or access denied

put.description: Updates policy/premium fields. Clients can only update their own policies; admin/super_admin can update any. Reassigning family_member_id re-validates ownership and refreshes the cached life_insured_name.

404.description: Policy not found or access denied

delete.description: Removes a life insurance policy. Clients can only delete their own; admin/super_admin can delete any.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all users. Only accessible by admin and super_admin roles.

put.description: Changes the authenticated user's password after validating current password.

400.description: Bad request or current password mismatch

post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP code to the registered email address if an account exists.

200.description: If an account exists with this email, an OTP has been sent.

post.description: Authenticates a normal user (client or advisor) using registered Email + Password. Admin/super_admin accounts cannot log in through this endpoint — use POST /admins/login instead. Returns a JWT token containing the user's role. Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed attempts.

parameters.description: Login credentials — registered Email and Password
parameters.name: request

200.description: Login successful — returns JWT token and user details with role

401.description: Invalid credentials, account disabled, or account temporarily locked

get.description: Retrieves profile information for the currently authenticated user.

put.description: Updates authenticated user's name and contact phone number. Works for every role (client, advisor, admin, super_admin) — an admin can update their own name/phone the same way. Email is immutable and cannot be modified by anyone through this endpoint.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account and wipes all associated E-Vault documents (from Cloudinary), family details, and insurance policies. Not available for admin/super_admin accounts — an admin account can only be deleted by a super_admin via DELETE /admins/{id}.

post.description: Creates a new user account with the specified details. Default role is 'client'.
Verifies the OTP code and updates the user's password in the database.

400.description: Invalid OTP, password mismatch or weak password

post.description: Validates if the provided 6-digit OTP code is valid, unexpired, and unused.

get.description: Retrieves a user's details by their MongoDB ObjectID. Requires authentication.

put.description: Updates user details (name, email, phone, role). Requires authentication. Only a super_admin may modify an existing admin/super_admin account or assign the admin/super_admin role.

403.description: Forbidden — only super_admin can modify admin accounts or assign admin roles

delete.description: Deletes a user by ID. Only accessible by admin and super_admin roles. Only a super_admin may delete an existing admin/super_admin account.

403.description: Forbidden — admin role required, or only super_admin can delete admin accounts

category.description: e.g. Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Bank Passbook, Policy, Custom

is_mapped.description: Admin tracking flag — admin/super_admin only can change on update
Admin tracking flag — admin/super_admin only can change on update

primary_insured_name.description: Cached from the linked family member

is_mapped.description: Admin flag: formally mapped to their agency portfolio

life_insured_name.description: Cached from the linked family member

BearerAuth.description: Enter your Bearer token in the format: **Bearer <token>**
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
